intro: Every action, from the govee CLI, Rust, Python, Node.js or a DMX console.

entries.title: scan
entries.summary: Look for devices and report what answers.
entries.detail: `scan_on` scans only the modes you name, and never enables a mode the configuration leaves out.

examples.rust:
let devices = govee.scan().await?;
let lan_only = govee.scan_on(&[Mode::Lan]).await?;
examples.python:
devices = await govee.scan()
lan_only = await govee.scan_on(["lan"])
examples.node:
const devices = await govee.scan()
const lanOnly = await govee.scanOn(['lan'])

entries.title: devices
entries.summary: List the devices already known. It touches no network.
entries.detail: The `lan` cache answers from disk, so a device found once needs no new scan.

entries.title: select
entries.summary: Name devices by identity, by SKU, by name or by group.
entries.detail: A target is an identity (`1C:8B:…`), a SKU (`H6159`), a configured name (`kitchen`) or a group (`ambient`). Prefix it with `id:`, `sku:`, `name:` or `group:` where the kind is ambiguous. `select` reads the devices already known, so scan first.

examples.cli:
govee devices H6159
govee devices kitchen ambient
govee on kitchen
examples.rust:
let chosen = govee.select(["H6159", "kitchen"], None)?;
let kitchen = govee.device(&govee.target("kitchen")?);
examples.node:
const chosen = govee.select(['H6159', 'kitchen'])
const kitchen = govee.device('kitchen')

entries.title: group
entries.summary: Send one command to every device of a group at once.
entries.detail: `groups:` in the configuration declares the members. Each member answers its own outcome, and a member that fails stops no other one.

examples.cli:
govee on ambient
govee brightness group:ambient 40

entries.title: identify
entries.summary: Light each device in turn, so a person maps an identity to a fixture in the room.
entries.detail: The walk turns every device off, lights them one at a time, then turns them all off. It answers the devices it lit, the devices that failed and the devices that stayed lit.

examples.cli:
govee identify
govee identify H6159
govee identify 1C:8B:C4:A2:C0:46:64:6E kitchen

entries.title: describe
entries.summary: Report what the device file declares for a model.
entries.detail: It reads no hardware. Use it to see the range of every argument before you send a value.

entries.title: status
entries.summary: Ask the device for its current state.
entries.detail: `last_status` returns the state already known and sends nothing.

examples.rust:
let state = device.status().await?;
let cached = device.last_status();
examples.node:
const state = await device.status()
const cached = device.lastStatus()

entries.title: watch
entries.summary: Follow events: a device appears, a mode changes health.

examples.python:
async for event in govee.events():
    print(event)

entries.title: doctor
entries.summary: Report everything wrong with the configuration.
entries.detail: Run it first when a device does not answer.

entries.title: power
entries.summary: Turn the device on or off.

examples.cli:
govee on DEVICE
govee off DEVICE

entries.title: brightness
entries.summary: Set the brightness of the whole device.
entries.detail: The device file carries the range. A value outside it is an error, never a clamp. On a verified model `0` is clamped by the firmware to `1` and does not turn the device off.

entries.title: color
entries.summary: Set one color for the whole device.

entries.title: color_temp

action.title: Set the white temperature
action.summary: White and color are mutually exclusive: this ends the color the device shows.

entries.summary: Set the white temperature, in kelvin.
entries.detail: It ends color mode: white and color exclude each other.

entries.title: segment
entries.summary: Paint the zones.
entries.detail: One color fills every zone, and a list gives one color per zone. With `zones`, only the named zones change, which needs a mode that paints by mask. A zone count the unit does not render is refused.

examples.cli:
# One color per LED, in zone order. `describe` reports how many.
govee segment DEVICE --resolution native "#ff3d00,#00a3ff,#000000,..."
# The same list, from a pipe or a file.
echo "#ff3d00,#00a3ff,#000000,..." | govee segment DEVICE --resolution native -

entries.title: gradient

action.title: Interpolate between the zones
action.summary: The interpolation wraps from the last zone back to the first.

entries.summary: Set whether the firmware interpolates between zones, without painting.
entries.detail: The interpolation wraps from the last zone back to the first. Over a mode that carries the setting in its painting frame, it is refused: pass `gradient` to `segment` there.

entries.title: music

action.title: Play a music effect
action.summary: The device listens on its own microphone.

entries.summary: Play an effect the device renders from its own microphone.
entries.detail: The device listens with its own microphone, and nothing streams from your host. The effect numbers belong to the mode, and `lan` carries no music command. Set a color, a temperature or the power to end the effect.

entries.title: open_stream
entries.summary: Open the segment channel and keep it armed.
entries.detail: The stream reports the zone count and the frame rate measured on the unit. The colors end when you close it.

examples.cli:
# frames.txt: one frame per line, one color per zone.
govee stream DEVICE --resolution native < frames.txt
examples.rust:
let stream = device.open_stream(StreamOptions::default()).await?;
println!("{} zones at {} Hz", stream.zones(), stream.rate_hz());
examples.node:
const stream = await device.openStream()
console.log(stream.zones, stream.rateHz)

entries.title: set_zone
entries.summary: Set one zone of the stream.

examples.cli:
# One frame per line, one color per zone.
echo "000000,ff3d00,000000" | govee stream DEVICE --resolution 3

entries.title: set_all, fill and clear
entries.summary: Set every zone at once.
entries.detail: `set_all` takes one color per zone. `fill` gives every zone the same color. `clear` sets them to black.

entries.title: close
entries.summary: Close the channel.
entries.detail: Nothing else disarms the channel. `frames_superseded` counts the frames that a newer one replaced before they went out.

examples.cli: # The stream ends when standard input ends.

entries.title: govee-dmx profile
entries.summary: Print the channel table of one model, to patch a desk with.
entries.detail: Each personality is one table: `full` takes 6 channels, and `segment` and `pixel` take the zones the unit renders. It reads no hardware.

examples.cli:
govee-dmx profile H6159
govee-dmx profile H6159 --personality segment

entries.title: govee-dmx patch
entries.summary: Scan the LAN and write the patch the node runs from.
entries.detail: It gives the lowest free channels to each device with no entry, and never moves an entry the file already carries: the desk patches that address too.

examples.cli:
govee-dmx patch
govee-dmx patch --personality segment --universe 1
govee-dmx patch --dry-run

entries.title: govee-dmx identify
entries.summary: Light each patched fixture in turn, so a person reads the rig.
entries.detail: The walk lights the fixtures in patch order, over `lan`. `--address` lights the fixture that answers to that channel, and not only the one that starts there.

examples.cli:
govee-dmx identify
govee-dmx identify --address 33
govee-dmx identify --universe 1
govee-dmx identify H6159 kitchen

entries.title: govee-dmx run
entries.summary: Receive Art-Net on port 6454 and drive the patched devices.
entries.detail: The node answers every Art-Net poll, so a desk lists it and patches it. `--dry-run` prints what each fixture reads, and writes to no device.

examples.cli:
govee-dmx run
govee-dmx run --scan
govee-dmx run --dry-run --debug

entries.title: send
entries.summary: Send one entry of the device file, by name.
entries.detail: It works for a model this build has never heard of: the device file declares every argument, and the core checks its range. `read` does the same for an entry that answers.

examples.python:
await device.send("brightness", level=40)
reply = await device.read("status")
examples.node:
await device.send('brightness', { level: 40 })
const reply = await device.read('status')

entries.title: provision_wifi

action.title: Put it on a Wi-Fi network

entries.summary: Put a new device on a Wi-Fi network, over Bluetooth.
entries.detail: The password travels in plaintext: anything in Bluetooth range during the transfer can read it.

entries.title: Choose a mode
entries.summary: Restrict a command to one mode.
entries.detail: It never enables a mode the configuration leaves out, and it never falls back. A device that no enabled mode reaches is an error.

examples.rust:
let mode = device.serving_mode()?;
let health = device.health(Mode::Lan);
examples.node:
const mode = device.servingMode()
const health = device.health('lan')
